items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: So that's how Charlie Hathaway came in, and got credit, and Buck Linn, Ram because they had to score the harmony. And there were a lot of things I made my harmony on, too, backgrounds and a lot of things.

ctx.x: No, they didn't do too much heading. Ed Lewis and I were talking about that the other day. No, they wouldn't have been able to do any heads. Now, a lot of

heads came in when we got with Basie. Because I could write out a background of riff, what we call it, for the sax player background? Just write the lead? Herschel and those guys would play their harmony right with it, didn't have to write it. Say, write it later, when you get ready to publish. So that's how Charlie Hathaway came in, and got credit, and Buck Linn, Ram because they had to score the harmony.
